features.name: Fix a new Cortex Agent narration-leak shape in /briefing/today's summary
features.description: User reported the Daily Briefing overview rendering a leaked agent-planning preamble before the real summary ("Only one recommendation matched today's date exactly. features.description: Adds the one capability feat-054's harvest ETA and every existing recommendation still lack: projecting a *hypothetical* action's outcome, not just business-as-usual. risk_engine.predict_trend already computes a one-tick 'if this trend continues, no action taken' projection on every /workflow/run tick (stored as *_forecast_24h risk rows) -- this feature adds the 'with a specific named intervention' branch alongside it. Per the user's explicit 2026-07-25 decision, intervention effect rates (e.g. emergency_aeration on fish_pond: +0.8 mg/L dissolved oxygen per hour) live as Python constants in a new backend/app/services/scenario_engine.py, not a new Snowflake table -- this mirrors risk_engine.py's own existing precedent (its DO/temp/disease thresholds are already hardcoded Python, not Snowflake rows) and avoids a CoCo round-trip for what is domain-engineering-constant data the agent itself never needs to query directly (only backend Python consumes it, since Option B keeps all projection math deterministic). Reuses feat-054's shared linear-projection helper. New endpoint POST /assets/{asset_id}/simulate accepts an action name (or 'no_action'), computes the asset's current value + recent trend delta from its last 2 ASSET_READINGS rows, projects the driving metric at 6h/24h horizons both with and without the named intervention, then hands those real computed numbers to the Cortex Agent (same ask_agent() call /workflow/run already uses) to narrate the comparison in plain language and give a grounded recommendation.
features.user_visible_behavior: From an at-risk asset's detail page, the user can pick a real candidate action (e.g. 'run emergency aeration tonight') or 'do nothing', and see a plain-language, agent-narrated comparison of the projected outcome at 6h and 24h for each -- grounded in the asset's real current reading and recent trend, not a generic disclaimer.

features.name: Yield Estimation
features.description: Adds the one 'Roadmap' item (docs/FarmTwin-AI-Copilot.md) that turned out to be genuinely new capability rather than a duplicate of an existing one or a scope contradiction -- see the 2026-07-27 discussion that triaged all 6 Roadmap items and ruled out the other 5 (disease prediction already covered by predict_trend/Scenario Simulator; cost optimization needs $ data this schema doesn't track and was already explicitly passed over once, feat-053's notes; resource planning would just be query_farm_ops under a new name; water usage optimization needs volume data irrigation_status doesn't track; autonomous daily planning directly contradicts the human-approval-loop design this project is built around). Projects this cycle's expected harvest output from an asset's own real historical yield record (ASSET_HISTORY already has 2-3 real per-cycle yield rows for every one of the 5 asset types -- biomass_kg_harvested, eggs_produced, yield_tons_per_ha, fruit_production_tons, vegetable_yield_kg), adjusted for its current health condition: estimate = mean(historical yield records) * (health_score / 100). Deliberately simple and explainable rather than a fitted/regression model, since 2-3 historical records per asset would make anything fancier overfitting, not genuine precision. Confidence is a sample-size heuristic (more historical cycles = more confidence), not a statistical one, for the same reason. Same deterministic-Python-then-agent-narrates split as feat-054/055: the backend computes the real number, the agent only explains it. No new Snowflake objects needed -- reuses ASSET_HISTORY (already real) and the health_score already computed in main.py's _health_score(), so like feat-055 there's no CoCo prompt for this feature. Applies to all 5 asset types (broader than Harvest Planner, which is crop-only), since every type already has real yield history.

features.name: Before/after value-diff highlight when a Run Farm Tick completes
features.description: feat-057 already shows live per-asset progress while a tick runs and DemoTriggerButton already invalidates the 'assets'/'dashboard-summary' dataCache keys on completion, but nothing diffs old vs. new values -- the dashboard and map just silently refresh to whatever the fresh fetch returns, with no visual signal of *what* changed. For a hackathon demo this is the key 'before and after' moment the presenter needs: a judge watching the map should be able to see at a glance which asset(s) the tick actually affected. Adds: (1) lib/dataCache.ts gains invalidateAndWait<T>(key) (same as invalidate() but returns the freshly-fetched value so a caller can diff against a snapshot taken before the refetch) and setValue<T>(key, data) (writes an arbitrary value under a cache key and notifies subscribers, for keys with no fetcher); (2) new lib/tickDiff.ts computing a TickDiff (changed asset ids where status or health_score differs pre/post-tick, plus the farm_health_score delta) from before/after Asset[]/DashboardSummary snapshots, published under a dedicated 'tick-diff' cache key with a fixed on-screen duration before auto-clearing back to null; (3) DemoTriggerButton.handleJobDone becomes async: snapshots 'assets'/'dashboard-summary' via getSnapshot before calling invalidateAndWait on both, computes the diff, and publishes it; (4) DigitalTwinMap/MarkerFrame render a distinct short-lived amber 'just updated' glow (a new changed-flash keyframe, visually distinct from the existing status-colored spotlight-pulse and the hover-driven highlight-ring) on any marker in the diff's changed set; (5) DashboardPanel's health-score Card gets a brief flash treatment plus a real +/- delta chip next to the existing HealthGauge (which already has its own session-scoped trend arrow from feat-037 -- left untouched, this only adds a numeric delta on top, sourced from the same real diff instead of a separate comparison).
features.user_visible_behavior: When a Run Farm Tick finishes, any asset whose status or health actually changed gets a brief amber glow on its map marker (fading out after a few seconds) and the Farm Health card briefly flashes with a real '+N'/'-N' delta chip if the score moved -- so the audience can see exactly what the tick changed instead of the dashboard just silently updating in place.
